# C ABI shared library for WhiteoutFlakesLib — the layer the Rust crate
# under bindings/rust/ calls through. Every translation unit here except
# whiteout_flakes_shims.cpp is autogenerated; regenerate with
#   python -m tools.bindings.codegen flakes
#
# Exceptions stay ENABLED, unlike WhiteoutLib's equivalent target: the
# renderer's GPU bring-up path throws on device-creation failure, and the
# shim TU has to catch that rather than let it cross the C boundary.

set(_wf_c_sources
    whiteout_flakes_common.cpp
    whiteout_flakes.cpp
    whiteout_flakes_shims.cpp
)

add_library(whiteoutflakes_c SHARED ${_wf_c_sources})

target_link_libraries(whiteoutflakes_c PRIVATE WhiteoutFlakesLib)
target_include_directories(whiteoutflakes_c PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
)
target_compile_features(whiteoutflakes_c PRIVATE cxx_std_20)

# On Windows, DLL symbols aren't exported by default. Auto-export
# everything with C linkage so the Rust side resolves them without the
# codegen peppering its output with __declspec(dllexport).
set_target_properties(whiteoutflakes_c PROPERTIES
    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/c-dist"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/c-dist"
    ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/c-dist"
    WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON
    OUTPUT_NAME whiteoutflakes_native
)

# Static sibling for consumers that would rather not ship a loose DLL —
# Rust in particular, where `cargo build` producing a self-contained
# binary is the expectation rather than the exception.
if(WDX_BUILD_C_STATIC)
    add_library(whiteoutflakes_c_static STATIC ${_wf_c_sources})
    target_link_libraries(whiteoutflakes_c_static PUBLIC WhiteoutFlakesLib)
    target_include_directories(whiteoutflakes_c_static PUBLIC
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    )
    target_compile_features(whiteoutflakes_c_static PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
    set_target_properties(whiteoutflakes_c_static PROPERTIES
        ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/c-dist"
        OUTPUT_NAME whiteoutflakes_native_static
        POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON
    )
endif()
